manageMenu.empty.title: Make your menu in a few seconds
manageMenu.empty.body: Photograph your menu board, take a screenshot of your existing menu or drag in a PDF — our artificial intelligence will extract everything and automatically make your digital menu.
manageMenu.empty.note: Works with photos, screenshots, PDF and plain text. Before it is saved, you can review and edit everything.
manageMenu.category.countsTitle: Counts in the kitchen-capacity limit (set in Menu → Kitchen capacity)
manageMenu.category.allowNotesHelp: The food truck can always add a note; this is for customers
manageMenu.category.prepHelp: Set “Instant” for items like drinks or sauces. They won’t count in kitchen capacity.
manageMenu.category.otherVans: Vehicle 1. The other vehicles: the “Kitchen capacity” section.
manageMenu.uncategorized.title: Without category
manageMenu.uncategorized.body: ⚠ No category set — choose one (✏️) so each item shows in its section. Until then they are still shown on the order screens.
manageMenu.newCategory.title: New category
manageMenu.newCategory.notesTitle: Allow notes from customers for each item
manageMenu.newCategory.notesHelp: Lets customers add a note to each item (e.g. “no onion”). The food truck can always add notes to items. Every order also has a notes field for the whole order.
manageMenu.allergens.heading: Allergens
manageMenu.allergens.buildFirst: First make the menu — add dishes, then set their allergens
manageMenu.allergens.cardNotAllowed: Where your food truck trades, an allergen card alone may not be used, so customers see the allergens next to each dish. Confirm the allergens for each dish.
manageMenu.allergens.addCard: add an allergen card so customers see the allergen information
manageMenu.allergens.viewOnly: View only — only the owner can edit the allergens
manageMenu.allergens.uploadIntro: Upload your allergen card or paste the allergen information. Our artificial intelligence will extract it and arrange it clearly for customers.
manageMenu.allergens.dragOrTap: Drag and drop or tap to upload
manageMenu.allergens.needReview: {count, plural, one {# dish needs checking} other {# dishes need checking}} — customers don’t see the allergen information until confirmed
manageMenu.deleteItem.title: Remove {name}?
manageMenu.deleteItem.history: Old orders that contain this item stay saved.
manageMenu.deleteItem.body: This item will be hidden from your menu immediately. It won’t show on the customer order page nor in the “Add order” panel.
manageMenu.subcats.title: Sub-categories — {name}
manageMenu.item.createHint: Fill in the details, then add the item.
manageMenu.item.ingredientsHelp: Shown to customers on the ordering page
manageMenu.item.subcatHelp: Groups this item under a heading in its category on the order screens — e.g. “For meat-eaters”, “Vegetarian”. Leave empty if you don’t need it.
manageMenu.item.optionsHelp: Tick a group to offer it for this dish, then choose which of its options to show.
manageMenu.item.optionLocked: The required group must have at least one option for each dish
manageMenu.item.optionOffered: Offered — tap to hide for this dish
manageMenu.item.optionHidden: Hidden — tap to offer for this dish
manageMenu.item.allergenGateTitle: Set up the allergens for this dish in the allergen check.
manageMenu.item.allergenGateBody: Open the “Set up / check allergens” box in the “Menu” section — the guide walks you through confirming each dish.
manageMenu.item.photoHint: Square photos are best. JPG or PNG.
manageMenu.item.preorderHelp: Include this item in pre-orders. The timing and rule are set for all items in Settings → Pre-orders.
manageMenu.item.noGroups: No option groups yet — create them in “Extras and upsells”.
manageMenu.item.costHelp: Optional. How much one portion costs you in ingredients and packaging. Used only in your reports; customers never see it.
manageMenu.item.recipeOnly: Only what is in this dish’s recipe.
manageMenu.item.tooMany: Allergens ticked: {count}. Are they really all in this dish’s recipe? Allergens used elsewhere in the kitchen go in “The kitchen also works with” in the “Menu” section.

manageMenu.confirmDelete.withItems: Delete “{name}”? The items in this category will also be deleted ({count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}). This cannot be undone.

manageMenuImport.settingsReview.title: A few settings to check
manageMenuImport.settingsReview.saveFail: We couldn’t save that — you can change it in Settings.
manageMenuImport.settingsReview.intro: We set you up with some usual settings. Worth a quick look — you can change any of them later in Settings.
manageMenuImport.settingsReview.cancelAr: How long before pickup customers can cancel
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.bodySet: Check them before going live. Until then items are marked “allergens not set”.
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.body: Check them in Settings before going live. Until then items are marked “allergens not set”.
manageMenuImport.allergensNotSet.title: ⚠ Allergens and diet are not set yet
manageMenuImport.welcome.title: Welcome to HatchGrab
manageMenuImport.welcome.stop: You can stop and come back whenever you want.
manageMenuImport.welcome.body: The food truck {name} is set up. Next we’ll add the menu, then your first event.
manageMenuImport.offer.title: Use the menu from the demo?
manageMenuImport.offer.body: We saved the menu you uploaded — {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}. Use it as a starting point or upload another.
manageMenuImport.checkMenu.title: Check the menu
manageMenuImport.checkMenu.body: We saved the menu from the demo to your food truck, and you have changed it since — so your changes are kept. Have a look at it below.
manageMenuImport.upload.title: Import the menu
manageMenuImport.upload.body: Upload a photo of the menu board, a screenshot, a PDF or paste the menu as text. Our artificial intelligence reads it and makes your digital menu — you check everything before it is saved.
manageMenuImport.upload.confirmCancel: Cancel this import? Your check of this menu will be discarded.
manageMenuImport.processing.title: Analysing your menu
manageMenuImport.processing.body: Artificial intelligence is reading your items and sorting them into categories…
manageMenuImport.review.title: Check the imported menu
manageMenuImport.review.editLaterSetup: You can edit the names, prices, extras, allergens and diet information any time later.
manageMenuImport.review.editLater: You can edit the names, prices, extras, allergens and diet information any time in Settings.
manageMenuImport.review.noPrice: {count, plural, one {# item had no price} other {# items had no price}} that we could read
manageMenuImport.review.lastCategory: Your menu must have at least one category
manageMenuImport.review.deleteEmptyBody: It has no items, so nothing is lost.
manageMenuImport.review.moveTitle: {count, plural, one {Where should # item be moved?} other {Where should # items be moved?}}
manageMenuImport.review.moveBody: To delete “{name}”, its dishes must be moved somewhere — items without a category are not imported.
manageMenuImport.review.nameFirst: Give the new item a name before adding another
manageMenuImport.review.ready: {count, plural, one {# item is ready} other {# items are ready}} to add. Untick the ones you don’t want.
manageMenuImport.review.noPriceBody: Set a price for each of them or mark it as free — otherwise it will go live with the price {zero}. You can’t continue until you sort this out.
manageMenuImport.review.incomplete: Enter a name to add this item — empty rows are not imported.
manageMenuImport.extras.introSetup: Some dishes can be set up as one item that is customised or stay separate dishes. Choose how each should be shown. You can change this later.
manageMenuImport.extras.intro: Some dishes can be set up as one item that is customised or stay separate dishes. Choose how each should be shown. You can change this later in Settings.
manageMenuImport.extras.none: No dishes to group — every item is a standalone dish.
manageMenuImport.extras.grouped: Grouped · one item, the customer chooses
manageMenuImport.allergens.title: Allergens
manageMenuImport.allergens.detected: We found allergens in your menu. Choose below how to show them.
manageMenuImport.allergens.howShow: How do you want to show the allergens to customers?
manageMenuImport.allergens.skip: Skip the allergen setup for now
manageMenuImport.kitchen.title: Kitchen setup
manageMenuImport.kitchen.intro: Help customers know how long they will wait — you can always change this later.
manageMenuImport.kitchen.allExist: All categories already exist — no times to set.
manageMenuImport.kitchen.totalHelp: Set a total capacity to limit how many items the kitchen takes on in one window. Leave ∞ for no limit.
manageMenuImport.kitchen.saveAdd: Save and add to the menu
manageMenuImport.schedule.title: Add my schedule
manageMenuImport.schedule.intro: If your schedule is on your website, we can keep it updated automatically — or add the dates yourself.
manageMenuImport.schedule.websiteTitle: My schedule is on my website
manageMenuImport.schedule.takesTime: This can take up to 2 minutes — leave the page open.
manageMenuImport.schedule.ownSite: Your own website — not a Facebook or Instagram page.
manageMenuImport.schedule.photoTitle: Upload a photo of my schedule
manageMenuImport.schedule.dragChoose: Drag and drop or tap to choose
manageMenuImport.schedule.found: {count, plural, one {# date was found} other {# dates were found}} — they will be added to your schedule.
manageMenuImport.schedule.save: Save {count, plural, one {# date} other {# dates}}
manageMenuImport.schedule.manualDesc: Add them later in the “Schedule” section — nothing to do now.

manageMenuImport.schedule.blockedDomain: Use your website’s address — Facebook and Instagram pages can’t be read automatically.
manageMenuImport.schedule.saveFailed: We read your schedule, but couldn’t save it right now — try again.

manageMenuImport.schedule.keepChecking: We’ll keep checking this page and send you new dates for approval.
manageMenuImport.schedule.photoDesc: Photograph or paste the dates — we’ll read them for you to check.
manageMenuImport.schedule.noneFound: We didn’t find dates in that — try a clearer photo or add a date yourself.

manageMenuImport.discard.title: Discard this import?
manageMenuImport.discard.body: Your changes won’t be saved — the imported items, prep times and kitchen capacity won’t be added.
